about.title: About me
about.description: Full-stack developer at Synprovis, Informatiker EFZ, studying Computing & IT and Mathematics at The Open University.
about.text: I'm a developer from Switzerland with a federal diploma in application development (Informatiker EFZ). At Synprovis, I work as a full-stack developer in the team building Improve 2, the successor to the quality management software Improve 1.
about.studyText: Alongside my job, I study at The Open University, full-time and remotely, working towards a BSc (Honours) in Computing & IT and Mathematics. Studying remotely lets me combine university with work, so what I learn goes straight into practice. Mathematics also gives me a solid foundation for data analysis and AI.
about.projectsText: On the side, I work on projects of my own: from data analysis at hackathons to public-sector redesigns and websites for the self-employed.
about.workspaceAlt: Laptop on a desk by the window

sections.title: Responsible
sections.text: Giorgio Jacomella, Aarburg, Aargau, Switzerland. For any privacy question, write to giorgio@jacomella.dev.

sections.title: Contact form
sections.text: When you send the contact form, your name, email address and message are delivered to me by the form service Web3Forms. I only use them to reply to you and delete them once they are no longer needed. Web3Forms processes the data according to its own privacy policy.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.text: This website is hosted by Cloudflare. To deliver the pages and protect against attacks, Cloudflare processes technical data such as your IP address, browser and the time of the request.

sections.title: No tracking
sections.text: This website uses no cookies, no analytics and no tracking. Fonts are served from this website itself. Your light or dark mode choice is saved only in your browser.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection, you can ask what data I hold about you and have it corrected or deleted. Write to giorgio@jacomella.dev.
